scope: Two affected LRU trajectories after structural creation-opportunity repair; G/L remain labeled historical R2 comparators, not rerun or combined into a new matched estimate.
split: development; both original P1 scripts already exposed; no unseen claim
method_change: U selector governs only existing-State body candidates. Every pending batch reaches the shared maintainer for create/no-op; empty bank skips known-empty U selection. No forced State creation, old-event replay or Host change.

shared.events_and_permissions: same scoped user/tool events and explicit-reference source resolver

computational_limits: Selector calls are paid and consume the same 13-control cap. At small N, routing may cost more than all-state maintenance.
Existing directory construction still reads full Store records; only model-input body reduction is claimed when observed.
G/L/LRU are online system trajectories; later same-bank/LR controls are needed for isolated selector effects.
Shared multi-State updates are not claimed atomic in this slice.
scoring: Unchanged full original rubric, all failures retained. Root separately verifies initial events actually reach maintenance, substantive facts persisted, actual U/A/candidate bodies and later get/action/answers. No initial State or oracle partition.
source_freeze: Published Git/source/config/dependencies/input identity bound by actual prepare; no mutation throughout the two full runs.
stop_rule: Complete both through semantic/capacity failures; stop for infrastructure or deterministic execution-invalidity. No favorable suffix replacement or extra cases.
